title: Shadow of the Wyrm
author: Rowan Ashgrove
description: A young knight sets out to face the wyrm terrorizing the village of Emberfall.

sections.text: Smoke rises over Emberfall as the wyrm Vaelith circles the hills once more. The village elders look to you for help.

options.description: Head straight for the wyrm's lair
Seek the old sage in the forest first

sections.text: You climb the scorched hillside toward the lair. The heat grows unbearable as you near the entrance.

options.description: Push through the heat into the lair

consequence.text: Embers scald your arms as you press forward.

sections.text: The sage listens quietly, then hands you a vial of shimmering liquid. 'Wyrms remember kindness,' she says.

options.description: Drink the vial and head to the lair

consequence.text: Warmth spreads through you, steadying your nerves.

sections.text: Vaelith looms before you, eyes glinting with ancient intelligence. It does not attack, only watches.
Steel meets scale in a desperate battle. When the dust settles, Vaelith lies defeated, and Emberfall is safe.
Vaelith tilts its head, then nods slowly. An unlikely peace is struck between wyrm and village.
